critical_code_review_comments: HomeOnboardingTour.tsx: palette.trackBg/trackMuted + hexToRgbString(colors.accent) fix cleanly resolves the previous white-alpha invisibility in light mode — verified with computed styles.

HomeContinueToast.tsx line 141 uses `(globalThis as any).__alphaColor(colors.primary, '14')` for the icon chip background. If __alphaColor is not globally seeded before HomeContinueToast mounts, this will throw at runtime and hide the toast entirely. Recommend importing an in-module alpha helper instead of relying on a globalThis side-effect. Not observed because we could not trigger the toast in this run, but static risk.

HomeContinueToast is untestable via automated E2E for a free user (paid features redirect out of sidebar → no lastSidebarRoute persisted). Consider seeding `rac:lastSidebarRoute` from a low-cost free-tier route (e.g. /features/ai-chatbot or /library) to make the toast reachable in Playwright without upgrading the user.

HomeSocialProof only rotates testimonials via a timer; the only visible testimonial during our audit window was testimonial 2 (Marcus Williams / GlobalEd) — we could not force-observe testimonial 1 and 3 quotes rendering. All 3 use tx('home.social.testimonialN.text/role') per code, and fr.ts contains all 3 keys — considered compliant.
